content: Do not increase the dosage of this medication, take it more frequently, or use it for a longer duration than prescribed by your doctor. Prolonged use may lead to reduced effectiveness. If you notice that the medication is no longer working as well as it used to, consult your doctor. Do not adjust the dosage without medical guidance. Common side effects of this medication include dizziness, dry mouth, difficulty sleeping, irritability, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or constipation. Remember that your doctor has prescribed this medication because they believe the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. However, this medication may increase your blood pressure. Rarely, it can cause serious and potentially fatal lung or heart problems, such as pulmonary hypertension or heart valve issues. The risk of these complications increases with prolonged use or when combined with other appetite-suppressant drugs or herbal products. Severe allergic reactions to this medication are rare but possible. This is not a comprehensive list of side effects. If you experience any unusual symptoms, contact your doctor. Before taking benzphetamine, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to other sympathomimetic amines (such as pseudoephedrine, amphetamine, or phentermine), or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other problems. This medication may cause dizziness, and consuming alcohol or marijuana (cannabis) can worsen this effect. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or performing tasks that require alertness until you are sure you can do so safely. Refrain from consuming alcoholic beverages. If you have diabetes, monitor your blood sugar levels regularly as directed and share the results with your doctor. Benzphetamine should not be used during pregnancy, as it may harm an unborn baby. If you become pregnant or suspect you might be pregnant, inform your doctor immediately. Infants born to mothers who have used this medication for a prolonged period or in high doses may experience withdrawal symptoms, such as irritability or extreme tiredness. This drug may pass into breast milk and could have undesirable effects on a nursing infant. Breastfeeding is not recommended while using this medication. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Taking monoamine oxidase (MAO) inhibitors with this medication can cause a serious and potentially fatal drug interaction. Avoid taking MAO inhibitors (such as isocarboxazid, linezolid, methylene blue, phenelzine, or tranylcypromine) during treatment with this medication. Most MAO inhibitors should also not be taken for two weeks before starting this medication. Some products may contain ingredients that could raise your heart rate or blood pressure. Caffeine can increase the side effects of this medication. In the event of an overdose, if someone has serious symptoms such as passing out or trouble breathing, call emergency services immediately (911 in the U.S.). Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Do not share this medication with others. Appetite suppressants should not replace a proper diet. Laboratory and/or medical tests (such as blood pressure and heart/kidney function) may be performed while you are taking this medication. Keep all medical and lab appointments. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of the next dose or late in the evening, skip the missed dose. Take your next dose at the regular time. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
